title: PythonComponent
description: A GH Python Script component definition. Output exactly this structure — no prose, no markdown fences, no explanation. Only the raw JSON object.
rules: code is the complete Python source for the GH Python 3 Script component, as a single JSON string with escaped newlines.
Reference each input by its name as a variable inside code; assign each output by its name as a variable.
Every input/output name must be a valid Python identifier and unique within its own list.
type must be one of the allowed type hints. Use 'Geometry' or 'Text' when unsure; omit type for an untyped (any) parameter.
access is 'item' (default), 'list', or 'tree'. Use 'list' when code iterates over the whole input; 'item' when it expects a single value.
Inputs left unconnected on the canvas are not errors — write code that tolerates the parameters you declare.

code.description: Full Python source for the component.

inputs.description: Input parameters to create on the component. One entry per script variable read.

outputs.description: Output parameters to create on the component. One entry per script variable assigned.

name.description: Variable name used inside the script. Must be a valid Python identifier.

type.description: Physalia type hint for the parameter.

examples.description: Takes a list of points and a numeric radius, returns one sphere per point.
examples.code:
import Rhino.Geometry as rg

spheres = [rg.Sphere(pt, radius) for pt in pts]
